name: zdeclient_write_feature_sections_to_zar
description: zDEClient::WriteFeatureSectionsToZAR writes a reload dummy section and serializes crater/quicksand feature entries with numbered section names.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this ZAR callback; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zDEClient source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x457b40 validates writing an initial Dummy section with reloadFlag set, iterating g_zDEClient_FeatureListBegin to g_zDEClient_FeatureListEnd while writes succeed, clearing reloadFlag on copied entries, naming featureType 1 entries CraterN, naming featureType 3 entries QSandN, and skipping other feature types.
The native smoke verifies the produced ZAR records for Dummy, Crater0, and QSand0, and confirms crater/quicksand payloads preserve feature data while clearing reloadFlag.
